column1: # DWB-667 FIXED SITUATION SET. Written 2026-10-09 BEFORE any re-keywording.
# 30 situations, 6 per agent, across the five agents that hold the 288 live
# scars (13 Archie_DWB team-lead, 14 Pam_DWB pm, 21 Barry_DWB backend,
# HOW THEY WERE WRITTEN, because a situation set an author tunes is not a
# measurement. Each line was written from the AGENT'S ROLE and from work this
# project actually does - migrations, sprint close, gates, probes, reviews,
# handoff - and NOT from any row's keywords. The author of this file had read
# the live keywords of agents 13 and 21 before writing it and had not read
# 14, 28 or 38; that asymmetry is stated rather than hidden, and the per-agent
# numbers are reported separately so a reader can check whether 13 and 21
# behave differently from the three the author had not seen.
# THE SET IS FROZEN. The before-number and the after-number are both taken
# over exactly these 30 lines, with the matcher untouched between them. If a
# line is ever changed, both numbers are void and must be retaken.
